research_declaration.objective: Validate timely causal observations and compare prospective admission hypotheses before testing any return effect.
research_declaration.market_stress_hypothesis: Target 30-minute changes, allowing references up to 40 minutes old: Brent >= +3% and NQ <= -1.5%, or yen appreciation >= 0.75% and NQ <= -1.5%, or NQ absolute move >= 3% blocks the observed new-risk candidate in either direction. Current and reference quote sets each require <=15-minute cross-market skew.
research_declaration.sector_budget_hypothesis: At most one existing same-direction memory-stock position; joint current-equity-to-stop risk plus one original per-account plan is capped at the largest stock account equity times 0.25%.
research_declaration.thresholds_are: Fixed prospective research hypotheses, not fitted thresholds or loss guarantees.
research_declaration.daily_bonds: Diagnostics only; no unvalidated directional weights.
research_declaration.calendar_scope: Supplemental Japan CPI, BoJ and ECB. Original Fed/BEA and company protections remain in the original services.
